department: Department of Chemistry and Nanoscale Science (Klein College of Science)

deadline.value: Early admission deadline is January 15 for full consideration; the regular deadline is March 1, and late applications are accepted without a guaranteed place.
deadline.quote: To ensure consideration of your application, please complete your application before the early admission deadline of January 15

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required for application to this program.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required for application to the program

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is required; the program does not require any GRE scores.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores ARE NO LONGER REQUIRED FOR APPLICATION

supervisor.value: An admissions committee reviews applications and recommends admission to the Program Director.
supervisor.quote: An admissions committee will review applications and recommend to the Program Director whether each applicant should be admitted

funding.value: Each new student is offered a 9-month TA, and funding is guaranteed for five years if satisfactory progress is kept.
funding.quote: Financial support, in the form of TA or Research Assistantship (RA) funding of at least $26,000 per academic year, is guaranteed for five years

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or a master's degree in a relevant science or engineering field is required.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a science or engineering discipline relevant to nanoscale science is required

notes: Department states no fee, TOEFL or IELTS minimum of its own; the Graduate School rules apply. The older Nanoscale Science sub-page lists March 1 and June 1; the current chemistry page is used.
